sloka: ततः सङ्क्षोदयित्वा तामोषधीं वानरोत्तमः ।लक्ष्मणस्य ददौ नस्तः सुषेणः सुमहाद्युतेः ।। ६.१०२.३५ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ saṅkṣodayitvā tāmoṣadhīṁ vānarottamaḥ ।lakṣmaṇasya dadau nastaḥ suṣeṇaḥ sumahādyuteḥ ।। 6.102.35 ।।

translations.english: Like a dark cloud filled with water carried by wind, Hanuman held the mountain peak and went in the air from the surface of the earth.
